verdict.rationale: The core DBOS product is an open-source library that runs inside your own application and needs no infrastructure besides Postgres (dbos-docs-2, dbos-docs-20, dbos-gh-1, dbos-docs-24). The Conductor management plane and DBOS Console can also be self-hosted, for example via Docker Compose, and dbosctl works against a self-hosted Conductor (dbos-docs-19, dbos-docs-34, dbos-docs-33). Community comments that observability and the web UI were not self-hostable or open source (dbos-comm-8, dbos-comm-11) look older: one says a self-hostable version was coming, which the current docs now describe. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of self-hosted Conductor/Console, and evidence that the Console UI is open source rather than only self-hostable.
